menus.name: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies
menus.body: A timeless bakery favorite, chocolate chip cookies are made with a buttery dough that balances sweetness and richness perfectly. The cookies bake into a golden-brown round with crispy edges and a soft, chewy center. Each bite is filled with melting chocolate chips that create a comforting and nostalgic flavor. They are simple, warm, and universally loved—perfect as a snack, dessert, or paired with milk.

menus.name: Brownie
menus.body: Brownies are a decadent dessert bar known for their dense, fudgy interior and rich chocolate flavor. Made from melted chocolate, butter, eggs, and sugar, brownies offer a deep cocoa taste and a slightly crisp, crackly top. They can be enjoyed plain or enhanced with toppings like walnuts, chocolate chunks, or caramel swirls. Brownies appeal to chocolate lovers who crave a moist, indulgent treat with a melt-in-your-mouth texture.

menus.name: Dubai Chocolate
menus.body: Dubai-style chocolate dates are a luxurious Middle Eastern confection. Each piece features a naturally sweet date carefully pitted and filled with nuts such as almonds or pistachios. The filled date is then coated in a smooth layer of high-quality chocolate. These treats are known for their rich, elegant flavor profile—combining caramel-like sweetness from the date, crunch from the nut, and creaminess from the chocolate. Popular as gifts and festive snacks, they represent premium craftsmanship and indulgence.

menus.name: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
menus.body: The Basque Burnt Cheesecake is a rustic, crustless dessert famous for its dark, caramelized exterior and creamy, custard-like interior. Baked at a high temperature, the top becomes beautifully burnt and cracked, creating a bittersweet contrast that complements the rich cream cheese filling. Despite its simple ingredients—cream cheese, sugar, eggs, and heavy cream—it delivers a deep, sophisticated flavor. Its texture is silky and melt-in-your-mouth, making it a standout cheesecake style.

menus.name: Banoffee
menus.body: Banoffee is a creamy, layered dessert that combines buttery biscuit crust, smooth caramel or toffee, fresh bananas, and soft whipped cream. Each layer brings a different sensation: the crunch of the base, the sweetness of the caramel, the fruitiness of ripe bananas, and the lightness of the cream. Often topped with cocoa powder or chocolate shavings, banoffee delivers a rich yet refreshing balance of flavors. It is a no-bake dessert that feels indulgent, comforting, and satisfying.
ingredients: dulce de leche or caramel sauce

menus.name: Macaron
menus.body: Macarons are delicate French almond meringue cookies that sandwich a flavorful filling such as buttercream, ganache, or fruit jam. Their smooth, shiny shell and iconic “feet” make them visually elegant, while their texture blends crispness and chewiness. Each macaron can carry unique flavor combinations—from classic vanilla and chocolate to fruity, floral, and seasonal varieties. Macarons are known for their precision and artistry, making them a premium bakery item.
utensils: stand mixer or electric hand mixer
silicone baking mat or parchment paper

menus.name: Steamed Pandan Layered Cake
menus.body: Khanom Chan is a traditional Thai dessert made by steaming multiple thin layers of tapioca flour, rice flour, coconut milk, and pandan juice. Its bright green color and subtle pandan aroma make it both beautiful and fragrant. Each layer is soft, chewy, and slightly sticky, offering a playful, peel-apart eating experience. The flavor is mildly sweet and coconut-rich, making it a nostalgic dessert often enjoyed at celebrations and festivals.
ingredients: fresh pandan leaves or pandan extract
utensils: heatproof steaming tray or silicone molds

menus.name: Bua Loi
menus.body: Bua Loi is a warm Thai dessert consisting of small, colorful rice flour balls served in creamy coconut milk. The chewy balls—often naturally colored with taro, pumpkin, or pandan—float in a fragrant, lightly sweetened coconut broth. Sometimes an egg is added (Bua Loi Kai Wan) for extra richness. The dessert is comforting, warm, and smooth, offering a blend of textures and flavors that feel both traditional and homey.

menus.name: Intanin
menus.body: Inspired by popular drinks from the Inthanin café chain, the Intanin-style iced chocolate is a refreshing beverage made from cocoa powder, milk, and sweet syrup. It has a deep chocolate flavor balanced with creaminess and sweetness, served over ice for a cool and energizing experience. The drink is smooth, rich, and satisfying—ideal for chocolate lovers looking for a quick and refreshing treat.
